name: Dogs vs Goblins
summary:
Lots of missing dogs lately in the near-by villages. Something seems strange. You need to find and rescue them until it's not too late. Turns out the goblins abducted the dogs.

Pet to Survive
Goblins hit hard, and your health takes a beating with every fight. To stay alive, you need to pet your dogs. Use your hands to scratch their ears, stroke their backs, and give them love.
